title: [epic] ActivityPub federation — bridge newsgroups to the Fediverse
description:
Why: The Corundum integration (planned, not v1) will define an rfc822+mime activity type whose content reference is a usenet-ipfs article root CID. ActivityPub federation is the natural complement: posting to a newsgroup fans out to ActivityPub followers on Mastodon, Pleroma, Misskey etc., and ActivityPub Create activities targeting a group address are injected as articles. This bridges the Usenet world to the modern federated social web.

What:
- Each newsgroup is represented as an ActivityPub Actor (type: Group or Service) with a stable URL.
- Inbound: ActivityPub Create{Note} activities addressed to a group actor are translated to RFC 5322 articles and injected via the POST pipeline.
- Outbound: each new article ingested to a group is published as an ActivityPub Create{Note} activity to the group actor's followers.
- WebFinger endpoint for group actor discovery.
- HTTP Signatures (Mastodon-compatible) for outbound activity signing.
- Article CID included in the activity as a custom property (as per Corundum rfc822+mime design).
- Federated replies: if an article has In-Reply-To, the corresponding ActivityPub activity includes inReplyTo.
- Configurable per-group: some groups may not be federated.

Note: This epic is closely related to the planned Corundum integration. Design choices here must not foreclose the Corundum rfc822+mime activity type. Coordinate before implementing.
